jobs.title: Principal Toxicologist (Ph.D.)
jobs.description:
About Exponent

Exponent
 is the only premium engineering and scientific consulting firm with the depth and breadth of expertise to solve our clients’ most profoundly unique, unprecedented, and urgent challenges.  

We are committed to engaging multidisciplinary teams of science, engineering, and regulatory experts to empower our clients with solutions that create a safer, healthier, more sustainable world. For over five decades, we've connected the lessons of past failures with tomorrow's solutions to advise clients as they innovate technologically complex products and processes, ensure the safety and health of their users, and address the challenges of sustainability.   

Join our team of experts with degrees from top programs at over 500 universities and extensive experience spanning a variety of industries. At Exponent, you’ll contribute to the diverse pool of ideas, talents, backgrounds, and experiences that drive our collaborative teamwork and breakthrough insights. Plus, we help you grow your career t hrough collaboration, our rich client network, and our excellent support staff . Thanks for your interest in joining our team!

Key statistics: 

950+ Consultants 
640+ Ph.D.s
90+ Disciplines 
30+ Offices globally

Our Opportunity

We are currently seeking a n experienced consultant for a Principal Toxicologist
position in our  Health Sciences  Practice
. This position is open to all U.S. office location s . In this role, you will work as part of a team to provide a high level of leadership and collaboration on projects related to litigation support, toxicological evaluations, risk assessment, and risk communication involving a wide range of products and chemicals . This includes evaluating health hazards, mechanism s of action, dose response, exposure levels , and conducting comparative risk research, utilizing data science tools, assist ing with regulatory documents and analyses , and conducting risk assessments under a variety of regulatory and legal paradigms . As a Principal Toxicologist, you will lead projects, identify new clients, expand relationships with existing clients, develop technical staff, and develop new business in related Health Sciences areas, particularly in the area s of product stewardship, toxic tort, and emerging chemicals of concern. You will be instrumental in helping our clients make and support data-driven and scientifically sound decisions to address today's most pressing issues impacting human health safety.

You will be responsible for

Leverag ing deep knowledge in toxicology to address a wide range of complex human health challenges across diverse client sectors , delivering scientifically rigorous and impactful solutions
Identify ing , pursu ing , and secur ing new client engagements by understanding emerging needs and building long-term partnerships.
Maintain ing and grow ing trusted relationships with existing clients by consistently delivering high-quality work, anticipating future needs, and serving as a strategic advisor.
Build ing , manag ing , and empower ing multidisciplinary teams, fostering a collaborative and inclusive environment that values diverse perspectives and scientific integrity.
Provid ing guidance, coaching, and professional development opportunities to technical staff, supporting their growth into future leaders and experts.
Ensur ing successful project execution through effective planning, resource allocation, and budget management, while maintaining high standards of quality and timeliness.
Offer high-level scientific and strategic advice to both internal stakeholders and external clients, contributing to the firm’s thought leadership and client impact.
Enhance the firm’s visibility and credibility by publishing in peer-reviewed journals, presenting at industry conferences, leading seminars, and participating in expert advisory or technical committees.

You Will Have The Following Skills And Qualifications

PhD in Toxicology or a related scientific field
Minimum of 8 years of consulting experience in the toxicology space
Proven track record of business generation and attracting new and repeat clients or funding
Diplomate of the American Board of Toxicology (DABT)
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly and persuasively to diverse audiences
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make informed recommendations in your scientific field
Outstanding reputation among clients and the scientific community for integrity, responsiveness, and technical expertise
Adept people management abilities coupled with extensive experience in successfully overseeing and executing complex projects
Strong commitment to professional development 

Applicants are encouraged to submit a CV (Curriculum Vitae) with publications (feel free to include publications that are in review or pending) [not restricted to 1 page].

Life @ Exponent

To learn more about life at Exponent and our impact, please visit the following links:

https://www.exponent.com/careers/life-exponent

https://www.exponent.com/company/our-impact

 Attracting, inspiring, developing, and rewarding exceptional people with diverse backgrounds and expertise are central to our corporate culture. Our diverse team allows us to provide better value to our clients and enjoy an enriched work environment.

 Our firm is committed to offering a variety of programs and resources to support health and well-being. We believe that providing competitive benefits as well as compensation and recognition programs empowers our staff to do work that makes a difference.

Work Environment

At Exponent, we have found that in-person interactions deepen employee engagement and are crucial for development, for realizing the full potential of our talented and diverse teams, and for building a more inclusive workplace where all have a sense of belonging. In our offices, you can expect a supportive culture and a collaborative, dynamic, multi-disciplinary work environment. Our consultants engage in-person in the office unless they are traveling for client work or other business activities.

We value the rich lives our colleagues enjoy outside of work and understand that work/life balance is critical to our employees and their well-being. Consultants have the autonomy to balance their work and personal schedules so you can meet with clients, visit inspection sites, attend conferences, and make time for priorities outside of work, too. It is this flexible, agile work style and working hours that allow our teams to drive innovation and results in their own ways, while meeting the needs of clients.

Compensation

Our consultants are rewarded for their technical and business contributions and have an opportunity to plan for future success and career growth. Exponent's total compensation plan is consistent with its expectations of the quality and quantity of work performed and with the professional standards set by Exponent. At the Manager level and above, total compensation includes base salary, annual bonus, and 401(k) employer contribution of 7% of base salary.

The base salary range for this position is depending on experience and capabilities which will be assessed during the interview process.

Salary Range

USD $200,000.00 - USD $300,000.00 /Yr.

Benefits You Will Enjoy

Access benefits information on our Life@Exponent page: https://www.exponent.com/careers/life-exponent

Exponent is a proud equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status.

If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, you may email us at HR-Accommodations@exponent.com .

Job Locations

US-CA-Oakland

US-Washington, DC

US-CA-Irvine

US-CO-Denver

US-NY-New York

US-TX-Austin

US-MA-Natick

US-CA-Oakland

US-WA-Seattle

jobs.title: EOI - Engineers | Technicians | Project Managers | Environmental Scientists
jobs.description:
Job Description

Expression of Interest - Engineers | Technicians | Project Managers | Environmental Scientists

Bring your expertise. Build something meaningful— and a great life — in Bundaberg.

Are you an experienced technical or project professional looking for greater influence, meaningful regional work and the opportunity to grow your leadership career?

Join GHD’s close-knit Bundaberg team and help shape projects that support communities across the Wide Bay. You’ll enjoy the visibility and connection of a regional office, backed by the capability, opportunities and multidisciplinary expertise of GHD’s wider Queensland and global network.

GHD is seeking Expressions of Interest
from experienced professionals interested in joining our Bundaberg team and leading our growth and presence across the Wide Bay region.

We’re deliberately keeping our search broad. Your project management or technical background could be in transport, civil, water, structural, electrical, environment or another technical discipline. What matters most is your ability to bring strong consulting experience, work closely with clients and contribute to both project delivery and business growth.

Build your career, and a great life, in Bundaberg

A move to Bundaberg could mean creating more space for what matters while continuing to work on meaningful projects, build trusted client relationships and grow your professional influence.

Bundaberg combines the serenity of coastal living with a strong sense of community and connection. The region is the closest mainland gateway to Lady Musgrave and Lady Elliot islands — two of the Southern Great Barrier Reef’s finest coral cays — and is surrounded by beaches, mangroves, and other ecosystems that support diverse marine life.

The region also offers the everyday essentials that make relocation easier: accessibility to Brisbane, modern schools, growing recreational opportunities, and high-quality healthcare facilities and upgrades. A diversified regional economy supports employment, investment and a lifestyle that guarantees a rewarding alternative to the hustle and bustle of major-city living.

At GHD, you’ll become part of a close-knit local team where your contribution will be visible and valued. You’ll work alongside people with deep regional knowledge while being widely supported by multidisciplinary colleagues across Queensland and GHD’s global network. It’s an opportunity to build local relationships, broaden your experience and make a lasting impact on the communities around you.

Discover what life in the Bundaberg region could offer you.

What could your opportunity look like?

Depending on your experience and background, you could join us as an Engineer, Technician, Project Manager or Environmental Scientist. In our Bundaberg team, you’ll have the opportunity to work across disciplines, build strong relationships with regional clients and play a visible role in the continued growth of our Wide Bay business.

Regional consulting can offer broader exposure and greater influence. You may find yourself working more closely with clients, contributing across the full project lifecycle and helping shape opportunities from their earliest stages — while still having access to the technical depth and career pathways of a global professional services company.

You may already be an established senior professional, or you may be ready to broaden your influence, take on greater client and commercial responsibility and continue developing towards future leadership opportunities.

This opportunity isn’t defined by a single technical discipline. We’re looking for the right capability, consulting mindset and client orientation to complement our Bundaberg team and contribute to our continued growth across the region.

What You’ll Bring

We’d like to hear from you if you bring:

5 plus years’ experience in consulting, technical delivery or project management
A background in engineering, environment, project management or another relevant technical discipline
Strong client-facing and relationship-building capability
A commercial mindset and an interest in identifying and developing opportunities
The ability and willingness to contribute directly to project delivery
A collaborative approach and the ability to work across disciplines, projects and locations
An interest in contributing to the continued growth of our Bundaberg business
The ambition to continue developing your career and potentially move into broader leadership over time
Relevant professional accreditation for your discipline, such as RPEQ and/or CPEng, or working towards attaining accreditation where applicable

You don’t need to already know the Queensland market. We’re interested in professionals who bring the right consulting and client-focused approach, valuable experience and a willingness to collaborate with colleagues who have strong local market knowledge.

Why GHD?

At GHD, you’ll have the opportunity to combine your technical expertise, project experience and client relationships while being connected to a broader multidisciplinary business.

This isn’t about fitting into a narrowly defined role. We’re interested in what you could bring to Bundaberg.

Whether you’re an experienced engineer, project manager, technical specialist or consultant looking for greater influence, broader client exposure and an opportunity to contribute to regional growth, we’d like to hear from you.

Could Bundaberg be your next move?

Register your interest and start a confidential conversation with us about your experience, career goals and what life and work with GHD in Bundaberg could look like. Explore the region at bundabergregion.org.

GHD is an equal opportunity employer, and we want everyone to be able to fully participate in our recruitment process. We value a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and people of all identities.

GHD embraces a range of flexible work practices to create a work environment focused on well-being, flexibility and productivity where our people can thrive.

We respectfully ask that no agency resumes be presented at this stage.

About Us

Come together and make a meaningful impact.

We bring our people together to create something bigger and solve some of the world's most complex problems. Come and experience the power of commitment and see strategy and ideas come to life when you join GHD.

Let's drive real change.

Our Pledge to You

At GHD, we don’t just believe in the power of commitment, we live and breathe it every day.

That’s why we pledge to empower our people to make a positive impact. Combining our deep technical expertise with the capabilities of our clients and partners, we respond to some of the most complex challenges facing our planet today.

See where your commitment could take you.

That’s the #PowerOfCommitment

Who We Are

GHD is a global professional services company that leads through engineering, architecture, and construction expertise. We are an employee-owned company with over 11,000 diverse and skilled individuals, across more than 200 offices spanning five continents.

The Power of Commitment is our brand promise. It’s what makes us different. We are bound to our stated vision and determination to address humanity’s most urgent needs: to make water, energy and urbanisation sustainable for generations to come.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Associate

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Civil Engineering, Industrial Machinery Manufacturing, and Environmental Services
